source: rust/crates/pbo-core/src/engine.rs (the presets are those of 1.x; a range of one's own is new)
about: The FFT sizes Prime95 tests, in K. A preset is a name, a range of one's own is written MIN-MAX. The smallest size is 4 and the largest 65536, and the smallest must not be above the largest. 'range' gives the sizes, 'text' the form written to plan files and the command line.

cases.name: spaces around the numbers do not matter
the smallest and the largest size are allowed
below the smallest size is nothing
above the largest size is nothing
words that are no preset are nothing
a preset is written by its name
a range of one's own is written MIN-MAX
